name: area-check
description: Holds the first edit a session makes to each existing source or test file, by an edit tool or a Bash command that writes it, when open p0 to p2 tech-debt or refactor issues name it or it is among the fastest growing large files; a shell write whose file cannot be named is held too wherever something could hold. A grey card shows the facts, and Claude decides through the mod's decide tool: proceed with a reason, fold an issue's fix in, or restructure, which asks Dan Restructure first, Proceed anyway or Fold in. Every judgement is logged outside ~/.claude, and when the mod itself fails the edit goes ahead with one dim line (#1506, #1508, #1509, #2142).
